title: NeoPixel Digit Layout
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: A seven-segment digit built from 14 NeoPixels; click segments, choose digits, show the strip path, rewire the order, and copy the SEG_PIXELS mapping as Python.

learningObjectives: Design a pixel-to-segment mapping for a NeoPixel digit
Apply the mapping and segment bytes to display a digit

keyQuestions: Which pixels light for the digit 2?
How does the wiring order change SEG_PIXELS but not DIGITS?
commonMisconceptions: Pixel numbers must follow the segment letters
Changing the wiring requires new digit bytes
assessmentOpportunities: List the lit pixels for a digit
Count the pixels needed for a four-digit clock with a colon
